base=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-medium-fresh0/frozen/held-out-reference/play/users/u071/system/state/workspace/programs')

code='''from collections import deque, Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    seen = set()
    components = []
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            q = deque([(r, c)])
            seen.add((r, c))
            cells = 0
            while q:
                y, x = q.popleft()
                cells += 1
                for ny, nx in ((y-1,x),(y+1,x),(y,x-1),(y,x+1)):
                    if 0 <= ny < h and 0 <= nx < w and (ny,nx) not in seen and grid[ny][nx] == color:
                        seen.add((ny,nx))
                        q.append((ny,nx))
            components.append((cells, color))
    color = max(components)[1]
    return [[color] * 3 for _ in range(3)]
'''

code='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    counts = Counter(value for row in grid for value in row)
    background = {color for color, _ in counts.most_common(3)}
    color = max((count, color) for color, count in counts.items() if color not in background)[1]
    return [[color] * 3 for _ in range(3)]
'''
